title: Floquet framework for driven polar quantum systems
summary: We present an analytical and numerical Floquet treatment of a driven polar two-level quantum system characterized by both longitudinal and transverse coupling to a periodic field. Analytically, we derive a dressed-frame effective Hamiltonian up to first order in the inverse driving frequency, incorporating the longitudinal coupling nonperturbatively. This yields closed expressions for the effective transverse coupling strength and the effective detuning, both of which are modified by the presence of the longitudinal interaction.
